function.name: lookup_customer
function.description: Find and VERIFY the caller's Summit Air account. Step 1: right after your first acknowledgment (and the safety check, if one applies), call with no arguments (uses caller ID). If it returns verification_required, ask where they need service and call again with street_address exactly as they said it. If there's no account for the number and they say they're an existing customer, call with last_name and street_address (zip optional; if the result says ambiguous with needs zip, ask for the ZIP and call again). Account details (first name, membership, addresses with ZIP, equipment, customer_id) are returned only when verified is true. Never read anything back before that.

phone.description: Phone number on the account, if different from caller ID. Any US format.

street_address.description: The street address AS THE CALLER SAID IT, e.g. 'thirty-seven twelve 82nd street' or '412 Seventh Ave'. Never fill this from a previous tool result.

last_name.description: Account holder's last name. Requires street_address; zip is optional.

zip.description: 5-digit ZIP code of the service address, only if the caller gave it. Omit rather than sending an empty string.
